research_question: What incremental net value does explicit Wayfinder add beyond vanilla durable handoff and Agentic Workflow with the same neutral durable-handoff intent?
network_policy: all evaluated processes use the same Codex workspace-write sandbox and an empty inherited shell environment; prompts prohibit external infrastructure mutation and the evaluator never runs terraform init, plan, or apply
environment_policy: a per-process minimal CODEX_HOME is created from the audited authentication material only; user config, rules, global skills, controller CODEX_* variables, cloud variables, and sibling/controller paths are not inherited by agent shells
